svg.title: esegal/soul.md: We shape our buildings, and then our buildings shape us.; Say little and do much.; Take a simple idea and take it very seriously.; Ответ нет у вас уже есть.; What you do is who you are.; Man plans, God laughs.; Bad ideas can hide in complexity, but they can't hide in simplicity.; If not now, when?; I don't know who discovered water, but it wasn't a fish.; Invert, always invert.; Everything is foreseen, yet freedom of choice is given.

g.text: and then our buildings shape us.
Ответ нет у вас уже есть.
What you do is who you are.
Bad ideas can hide in complexity,
but they can't hide in simplicity.
I don't know who discovered water,
yet freedom of choice is given.
